# Anthropic frontend-design — default clusters (summary)

From https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design — do not choose these by reflex when the brief leaves the axis free:

1. Warm cream (~#F4F1EA) + high-contrast serif + terracotta accent
2. Near-black + acid-green or vermilion accent
3. Broadsheet hairline / zero-radius dense columns

Process: brainstorm token plan → critique uniqueness → build → critique again. Ground choices in the subject’s world.
